seo.title: Contact
seo.description: Call {{phone}} or request a free on-site roofing estimate from {{name}} in {{city}}. Serving {{serviceArea}} and northwest Oregon. Oregon CCB #{{ccb}}.

hero.title: Tell us about the roof
hero.lead: Call, email or send the form. Say what you're seeing and where the house is, and we'll set a time to come look. The estimate is free and written down.

image.alt: An aluminum ladder laid up a brown shingle roof beside a brick chimney, under a blue sky

hero.caption: Most estimates start the same way: up the ladder for a close look at the shingles and the flashing.

next.title: What happens next

steps.title: We call you back
steps.body: If we miss your call, or you send the form or an email, we call you back; after hours, that's the next working morning. We'll ask a few questions so we come prepared.

steps.title: We set a time to visit
steps.body: A time that suits you. If we can judge the job from outside, you don't have to be home; if we need the attic, or you want to walk it with us, we'll come when you are.

steps.title: We walk the roof
steps.body: Slopes, flashing, penetrations, gutters and, if there's access, the attic. We take photos as we go and show you what we found.

steps.title: You get a written estimate
steps.body: Itemized and in plain words, with the materials named and the schedule set out. It's free, and there's no follow-up pressure.

next.area: We work anywhere in Oregon within about {{driveMinutes}} minutes' drive of our {{city}} shop, across {{countyCount}} counties from the Portland metro into the north Willamette Valley. See the service area map.

haveReady.label: Useful to have ready

items.title: The roof's age, if you know it
items.body: Or roughly when you bought the house. Closing paperwork and old invoices often have it.

items.title: Photos
items.body: Of the roof from the ground, a stain on the ceiling, a sagging gutter. A phone photo tells us a lot before we arrive.

items.title: Where you see water
items.body: Which room, how close to an outside wall or chimney, and whether it shows only in wind-driven rain.

items.title: Anything done before
items.body: Past repairs, a previous claim, or a second layer of shingles you know about.

items.title: Access
items.body: Gates, dogs, attic hatch location, and where a truck can park.

haveReady.note: None of it is required. If all you know is that there's a drip, call.
